system.description: You are considered proficient with Improvised Thrown Weapons when making a ranged attack by throwing an object. Objects up to one size category larger than you can be Thrown up to a number of squares equal to 2 x your Strength bonus (minimum 1 square). Additionally, you add your Strength bonus to any damage dealt.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
